{"message": "Fixed the Kconfig dependency for `MAX17048` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/fuel_gauge/max17048/Kconfig`.

### Cause
`config MAX17048` had `depends on !DT_HAS_MAXIM_MAX17048_ENABLED` instead of `depends on DT_HAS_MAXIM_MAX17048_ENABLED`. Because of the inverted condition, enabling a `maxim,max17048` devicetree node disabled `CONFIG_MAX17048` and `CONFIG_EMUL_MAX17048`, causing the driver and emulator source files not to be compiled and resulting in undefined reference linker errors.

### Fix
Changed `depends on !DT_HAS_MAXIM_MAX17048_ENABLED` to `depends on DT_HAS_MAXIM_MAX17048_ENABLED` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/fuel_gauge/max17048/Kconfig`.

### Verification
Built and ran `tests/drivers/fuel_gauge/max17048` on `native_sim`; all tests pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
